name: webstudio-merchant-account
description: Customer accounts and order emails for the Webstudio × Merchant shop template.

MERCHANT_ADMIN_KEY.description: Your Merchant admin key (starts with `sk_`). The setup script prints it after deploying Merchant.

SITE_ORIGIN.description: Your published Webstudio site, for example `https://shop.example.com`. Only this origin may call the Worker.

MAIL_FROM.description: Sender address on a domain onboarded to Cloudflare Email Sending. Needed for sign-in links and order emails.

SHOP_INBOX.description: Where "new order" emails go. Leave empty to skip them.
